role: exploratory pilot, not a confirmatory result
claim: How much does a typed decision degrade when the item arrives wrapped in conversation context, as it would inside an agent workflow? JevOut (arXiv:2609.30243) shows that optimised context can flip Jev's decisions. This pilot uses fixed, unoptimised context templates. It runs on test items every system has already been scored on, so its numbers size an effect and decide whether a full study is worth doing. Written before any wrapped item was scored.

banking77.distractors: Banking77 train rows outside the Program 1 dev split, drawn with a label different from the target and from each other

clinc150.items: the first 500 of the suite's CLINC150 test items in frozen order
clinc150.distractors: in-scope CLINC150 train rows, drawn the same way

conditions.chatter:
Customer: Hi there, hope you're having a good day.
Agent: Hello! Thanks, I am. How can I help you today?
Customer: Sorry, one second, my dog is barking. Okay, I'm back.
Customer: {target}
conditions.typed_summary:
Earlier decisions in this conversation: {l1} (resolved); {l2} (resolved); {l3} (resolved).
Current message: {target}

gold: the target's label in every condition

systems.jev-generic: jev_protocol.json request, instructions unchanged: Which label best describes the text?
systems.jev-current: same request with instructions: Which label best describes the customer's current message? Ignore earlier messages that are already resolved.
systems.ettin-encoder-log_loss: the float32 Banking77 checkpoint (seed 20261007), scored on the processor in float32, 128-token cap with the tail truncated as in training; Banking77 only
systems.gliclass-base-v3.0: the Program 1 system on the processor
systems.ettin-decoder-log_loss: added 2026-10-10 before it was scored on any wrapped item: the float32 Banking77 decoder (seed 20261007) on the GPU with its own recipe, which keeps the first 128 tokens of the text; Banking77 only
systems.qwen3-4b-index_prior: added 2026-10-10 before it was scored on any wrapped item: the suite's Qwen3-4B readout with the prior and temperature it has for Banking77; the wrapped text takes the place of the text in its prompt; Banking77 only

temperature: each system keeps the temperature it already has for the clean dataset; nothing is refit. Jev is reported as delivered.
metrics: accuracy and multiclass Brier per condition
mean top probability and top-label ECE
broken: of the items the system gets right in the clean condition, the share it gets wrong in this condition
repaired: of the items it gets wrong when clean, the share it gets right in this condition
for the encoder, the share of items whose wrapped text exceeds 128 tokens
not_in_this_pilot: CLINC150 for the decoder (no fine-tuned checkpoint) and for Qwen3-4B (about three hours of GPU)
